root_cause.text: The function `rio_scan_alloc_net()` in the RapidIO subsystem incorrectly called `rio_free_net()` to free a `rio_net` structure that had not yet been registered with `rio_add_net()`, and failed to clear the dangling pointer in `mport->net`, leading to potential use-after-free or memory corruption on error.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "When idtab allocation fails, net is not registered with rio_add_net() yet, so kfree(net) is sufficient to release the memory. Set mport->net to NULL to avoid dangling pointer." The patch changes `rio_free_net(net)` to `kfree(net)` and adds `mport->net = NULL`.
